architecture.conjunction: Match each READ policy to target organization/ancestor BEFORE combining only that matched policy's field groups; no scope+field cross join

architecture.notImplemented: Actual requested business field projection, native purpose/SoD publication, command/mutation atomic CAS fence, distributed revoke ordering, transport signature/session current binding, deployment integration
